Alex: Pushed a replay-driven sim for an opportunistic coalescer admission policy. Results and logs: https://short.url/op-coalesce-2123 :eyes:
Marie: Nice. Is this the run that mixes kernel-selection heuristics with KV prefetch gating?
Alex: yeah, the config toggles: coalesce_threshold=12, token_budget_target=0.6, kernel_prefer_small=true.
Juan: can you paste the exact config? trying to reproduce locally.
Alex: ```json
{
  "policy": "opportunistic_coalesce_v2",
  "coalesce_threshold": 12,
  "token_budget_target": 0.6,
  "kv_prefetch": "on-demand",
  "kernel_selector": "latency_cost_tradeoff"
}
```
Samir: skimmed logs — interesting spike in kernel switch count around trace idx 42. looks like we bounce between fused-attn and fallback matmul on mid-length sequences.
Kelly: what were the perf numbers? p50/p95/throughput?
Alex: summary from sim harness: p50=18ms (good), p95=96ms (worse), mean tokens/sec per-GPU = 21k, coalescing reduced small-batch overhead by ~11%.
Marie: p95 looks bad. is that because KV warmup wasn't hitting cache for interactive traces?
Samir: exactly. KV prefetch was set to on-demand so cold starts cause kernel fallback and higher queue latency. I flagged two hotspots: KV bucket miss at lookup.shard 3 and kernel recompile path in the runtime.
Juan: any traces we can replay that reproduce the p95 tail?
Alex: trace ids attached in the gist. I replayed trace 2023-11-07T14:02 and saw the same spikes when coalescer merged a short request (8 tokens) with a long one (300 tokens) causing kernel selection oscillation.
Kelly: maybe we need an admission policy that avoids coalescing requests across >N length ratio. like if max_len/min_len > 6, don't coalesce.
Marie: good idea. let's try a quick A/B in offline harness: control = current coalescer, experiment = coalescer + length-ratio guard.
Samir: also try adjusting token_budget_target down to 0.45 for the experiment so we prioritize latency over throughput.
Alex: I can run both configs in the replay harness overnight. I'll attach the exact command:```bash
./replay_harness --traces traces/op_coalesce_set --config configs/op_coalesce_exp.json --runs 3
```
perf-bot: Automated note: replay run queued (id=op-coalesce-exp-212345). ETA ~8h.
Juan: quick thought on kernel churn: add a small hysteresis window for kernel_selector so a kernel change isn't triggered unless sequence length window shifts by >32 tokens. should reduce thrash.
Kelly: +1 on hysteresis. Also log a metric for "coalesce_length_ratio" so we can visualize when it's responsible for tail.
Marie: action items: Alex run A/B, Samir add KV warmup trace and metric, Juan prototype kernel hysteresis, Kelly add viz.
Alex: created PRs: #4123 (coalescer length-ratio guard), #4124 (token_budget tune to 0.45). I'll link when CI passes.
Samir: if the A/B shows p95 improvement without >5% drop in throughput we can promote the guard to default on Dedicated.
perf-bot: CI status for #4123: all checks passed. #4124: failing flaky-test-queue (investigating).
Juan: heads-up, the replay harness flags a regression when KV warmup increase >3x memory but reduces p95 by 40% — we need cost calc before promoting.
Kelly: noted. Alex, please include cost delta in the final A/B report (tokens/GPU-hour).
Alex: Will do. Will post results in this thread once the overnight runs finish. Thanks all :rocket:
perf-bot: Run op-coalesce-ctrl-212345 complete. Results summary: control p95=96ms, exp(presim)=68ms (prelim), throughput delta -6%. Full report will be uploaded to the gist when available.
